intro.en: Two friends, Majid and Nasser, talk about a bank robbery they saw on the news. You will learn words about crime and safety, and how to thank Allah for the blessing of security.
intro.ur: Do dost, Majid aur Nasser, khabron mein dekhi hui bank ki chori ke bare mein baat karte hain. Aap jurm aur amn se mutaliq alfaaz seekhenge, aur yeh bhi ke amn ki nematon par Allah ka shukr kaise ada karein.
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ صَديقانِ، ماجِدٌ وَناصِرٌ، عَنْ سَرِقَةِ مَصْرِفٍ شاهَداها في الأَخْبارِ. سَتَتَعَلَّمُ كَلِماتٍ عَنِ الجَريمَةِ وَالأَمْنِ، وَكَيْفَ نَشْكُرُ اللهَ عَلى نِعْمَةِ الأَمْنِ.

dialogue.ar: صَباحُ الخَيْرِ يا ناصِر.
dialogue.tr: ṣabāḥu l-khayri yā nāṣir.
dialogue.en: Good morning, Nasser.
dialogue.ur: Subah bakhair, Nasser.

dialogue.ar: صَباحُ النّورِ يا ماجِد.
dialogue.tr: ṣabāḥu n-nūri yā mājid.
dialogue.en: Good morning to you, Majid.
dialogue.ur: Subah bakhair, Majid.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ سَمِعْتَ خَبَرَ سَرِقَةِ المَصْرِفِ في المَدينَةِ المُجاوِرَة؟
dialogue.tr: hal samiʿta khabara sariqati l-maṣrifi fī l-madīnati l-mujāwirah?
dialogue.en: Have you heard the news of the bank theft in the neighbouring city?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ne paros ke shehar mein bank ki chori ki khabar suni?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، شاهَدْتُهُ في نَشْرَةِ الأَخْبارِ، وَقَدْ أَقْلَقَني كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, shāhadtuhu fī nashrati l-akhbār, waqad aqlaqanī kathīran.
dialogue.en: Yes, I watched it in the news bulletin, and it worried me a lot.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, maine khabron mein dekha, aur is ne mujhe bohat pareshan kiya.

dialogue.ar: هذا الحادِثُ جَديدٌ عَلَيْنا؛ فَما كُنّا نَسْمَعُ بِمِثْلِهِ مِنْ قَبْل.
dialogue.tr: hādhā l-ḥādithu jadīdun ʿalaynā; famā kunnā nasmaʿu bimithlihi min qabl.
dialogue.en: This incident is new to us; we never used to hear of anything like it before.
dialogue.ur: Yeh waqia hamare liye naya hai; hum ne pehle kabhi aisa kuch nahin suna tha.

dialogue.ar: لكِنَّني اطْمَأْنَنْتُ حينَ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ الشُّرْطَةَ قَبَضَتْ عَلى الجُناةِ بَعْدَ ساعاتٍ قَليلَة.
dialogue.tr: lkinnanī iṭmaʾnantu ḥīna ʿalimtu anna sh-shurṭata qabaḍat ʿalā l-junāti baʿda sāʿātin qalīlah.
dialogue.en: But I felt reassured when I learned that the police arrested the criminals after a few hours.
dialogue.ur: Lekin mujhe tasalli hui jab maloom hua ke police ne chand ghanton baad mujrimon ko pakad liya.

dialogue.ar: وَمَعَ ذلِكَ فَإِنَّ الجَرائِمَ بَدَأَتْ تَزيدُ في هذِهِ الأَيّام.
dialogue.tr: wamaʿa dhālik faʾinna l-jarāʾima badaʾat tazīdu fī hādhihi l-ayyām.
dialogue.en: Even so, crimes have begun to increase these days.
dialogue.ur: Phir bhi in dinon jurm barhne lage hain.

dialogue.ar: صَحيحٌ، لكِنَّها أَقَلُّ بِكَثيرٍ مِمّا نَسْمَعُ عَنْهُ في بِلادٍ أُخْرى.
dialogue.tr: ṣaḥīḥ, lkinnahā aqallu bikathīrin mimmā nasmaʿu ʿanhu fī bilādin ukhrā.
dialogue.en: True, but it is far less than what we hear about in other countries.
dialogue.ur: Sahi hai, lekin yeh us se bohat kam hai jo hum doosre mulkon ke bare mein sunte hain.

dialogue.ar: أَنا أُوافِقُكَ؛ فَقَدْ سافَرْتُ في العُطْلَةِ إِلى مَدينَةٍ كَبيرَةٍ، وَكُنّا لا نَخْرُجُ مِنَ الشَّقَّةِ مَساءً، خَوْفاً مِنْ جَرائِمِ السَّرِقَةِ وَالقَتْل.
dialogue.tr: anā ūfiquk; faqad sāfartu fī l-ʿuṭlati ilā madīnatin kabīrah, wakunnā lā nakhruju mina sh-shaqqati masāʾan, khawfan min jarāʾimi s-sariqati wālqatl.
dialogue.en: I agree with you; I travelled in the holiday to a big city, and we did not go out of the flat in the evening, for fear of crimes of theft and murder.
dialogue.ur: Main aap se mutafiq hoon; chhutti mein main ek bare shehar gaya, aur hum shaam ko flat se bahar nahin nikalte the, chori aur qatl ke jurm ke khauf se.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ تَقَعُ هذِهِ الجَرائِمُ هُناكَ في وَضَحِ النَّهارِ أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: waqad taqaʿu hādhihi l-jarāʾimu hunāka fī waḍaḥi n-nahāri ayḍan.
dialogue.en: And these crimes may happen there in broad daylight too.
dialogue.ur: Aur yeh jurm wahan din ki roshni mein bhi ho sakte hain.

dialogue.ar: أَخْشى أَنْ تَنْتَقِلَ العَدْوى إِلَيْنا، فَتَكْثُرَ الحَوادِثُ المُؤْلِمَة.
dialogue.tr: akhshā an tantaqila l-ʿadwā ilaynā, fatakthura l-ḥawādithu l-muʾlimah.
dialogue.en: I fear the infection will spread to us, and painful incidents will multiply.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe dar hai ke yeh asar hum tak pahunch jaye, aur takleef-deh waqiat barh jayen.

dialogue.ar: نَسْأَلُ اللهَ السَّلامَةَ لِبِلادِنا.
dialogue.tr: nasʾalu llāh s-salāmata libilādinā.
dialogue.en: We ask Allah for safety for our country.
dialogue.ur: Hum Allah se apne mulk ki salamti maangte hain.

dialogue.ar: الحَياةُ بِلا أَمْنٍ لا قيمَةَ لَها.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥayātu bilā amnin lā qīmata lahā.
dialogue.en: Life without security has no value.
dialogue.ur: Amn ke baghair zindagi ki koi qeemat nahin.

dialogue.ar: أَشْكُرُ اللهَ عَلى هذِهِ النِّعْمَةِ العَظيمَةِ، نِعْمَةِ الأَمْن.
dialogue.tr: ashkuru llāh ʿalā hādhihi n-niʿmati l-ʿaẓīmah, niʿmati l-amn.
dialogue.en: I thank Allah for this great blessing, the blessing of security.
dialogue.ur: Main Allah ka shukr ada karta hoon is azeem nemat par, amn ki nemat par.

dialogue.ar: آمينَ يا رَبَّ العالَمين.
dialogue.tr: ʾāmīna yā rabba l-ʿālamīn.
dialogue.en: Ameen, O Lord of the worlds.
dialogue.ur: Ameen, ae Rab-ul-aalameen.

q.en: What did the friends talk about?
q.ur: Dono doston ne kis baare mein baat ki?

options: A bank theft shown on the news

q.en: Who arrested the criminals after a few hours?
q.ur: Chand ghanton baad mujrimon ko kis ne pakda?
q.ar: مَنْ قَبَضَ عَلى المُجْرِمينَ بَعْدَ ساعاتٍ؟

q.en: What does «الأَمْنُ» mean?
q.ur: «الأَمْنُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: According to Majid, life without security is:
q.ur: Majid ke mutabiq amn ke baghair zindagi:
q.ar: قالَ ماجِدٌ إِنَّ الحَياةَ بِلا أَمْنٍ...

q.en: How do you say «blessing»?
q.ur: «Nemat» ko Arabi mein kya kehte hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تُقالُ لِلخَيْرِ الَّذي يُنْعِمُ اللهُ بِهِ عَلَيْنا؟

title.ur: Noon saakin aur tanween ka idgham

intro.en: A rule of recitation. When a silent noon (نْ) or tanween comes before one of six letters, يَرْمُلُون (ي ر م ل و ن), it is merged into the next letter. Example: مَنْ يَعْمَلْ is read like مَيَّعْمَلْ.
intro.ur: Tilawat ka ek qaida. Jab noon saakin (نْ) ya tanween ke baad in 6 huroof mein se koi aaye: ي ر م ل و ن (yarmaloon), to woh agle harf mein mil jata hai. Misal: مَنْ يَعْمَلْ ko aise parha jata hai jaise مَيَّعْمَلْ.
intro.ar: قاعِدَةٌ مِنْ قَواعِدِ التِّلاوَةِ: إِذا جاءَتْ نونٌ ساكِنَةٌ أَوْ تَنْوينٌ قَبْلَ أَحَدِ الحُروفِ السِّتَّةِ «يَرْمُلونَ» (ي ر م ل و ن) فَإِنَّها تُدْغَمُ في الحَرْفِ الَّذي بَعْدَها. مِثالٌ: «مَنْ يَعْمَلْ» تُقْرَأُ «مَيَّعْمَلْ».

vocab.ur: idgham, harf ka dusre harf mein milna

vocab.en: the six merge letters: ي ر م ل و ن

q.en: Which letters merge with a silent noon or tanween?
q.ur: Noon saakin ya tanween kin huroof mein mil jata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حُروفٍ تُدْغَمُ فيها النّونُ السّاكِنَةُ وَالتَّنْوينُ؟

options: ي ر م ل و ن
ب ت ث ج ح خ
أ ب ت ث ج ح
ك ف ق س ش ص

q.en: How many letters are in the rule?
q.ur: Is qaide mein kitne huroof hain?

q.en: What is the memory word for these letters?
q.ur: In huroof ko yaad rakhne ka lafz kya hai?
q.ar: ما الكَلِمَةُ الَّتي تَجْمَعُ هذِهِ الحُروفَ لِلْحِفْظِ؟

q.en: What does «إِدْغام» mean?
q.ur: «إِدْغام» ka matlab kya hai?

options: Merging a letter into the next
options_ar: إِدْخالُ حَرْفٍ في الحَرْفِ الَّذي بَعْدَهُ

intro.en: After numbers 11 to 90 the counted thing (tamyīz) is singular and ends with fatha-tanween, e.g. أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَباً (eleven planets). After 100 and 1000 it is singular and in the genitive, e.g. مِئَةُ طالِبٍ (a hundred students).
intro.ur: 11 se 90 tak ke adaad ke baad ginti wali cheez (tamyeez) wahid hoti hai aur mansoob (fatha ke saath tanween), jaise أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَباً (gyarah sitare). 100 aur 1000 ke baad woh wahid aur majroor hoti hai, jaise مِئَةُ طالِبٍ (sau talib-ilm).
intro.ar: بَعْدَ الأَعْدادِ مِنْ ١١ إِلى ٩٩ يَكونُ المَعْدودُ (التَّمْييزُ) مُفْرَداً مَنْصوباً، مِثْلَ: أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَباً. وَبَعْدَ ١٠٠ وَ١٠٠٠ يَكونُ مُفْرَداً مَجْروراً، مِثْلَ: مِئَةُ طالِبٍ.

q.ur: 11 se 90 ke baad tamyeez hoti hai:
q.ar: بَعْدَ الأَعْدادِ مِنْ ١١ إِلى ٩٩ يَكونُ المَعْدودُ...

q.en: After 100 and 1000 the counted noun is:
q.ur: 100 aur 1000 ke baad tamyeez hoti hai:

intro.en: You listen to a news item about six robbers who took money from a plane in a South American country, then practise asking and answering questions about crime in your country.
intro.ur: Aap ek khabar sunte hain jis mein chhe daakuon ne Janubi Amrika ke ek mulk mein jahaz se raqam loot li, phir apne mulk ke jurm ke bare mein sawal jawab ki mashq karte hain.
intro.ar: تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى خَبَرٍ عَنْ سِتَّةِ لُصوصٍ أَخَذوا أَمْوالاً مِنْ طائِرَةٍ في إِحْدى دُوَلِ أَمْريكا الجَنوبِيَّةِ، ثُمَّ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى السُّؤالِ وَالجَوابِ عَنِ الجَريمَةِ في بَلَدِكَ.

dialogue.ar: سِتَّةُ لُصوص.
dialogue.tr: sittatu luṣūṣ.
dialogue.en: Six robbers.
dialogue.ur: Chhe chor.

dialogue.ar: في إِحْدى دُوَلِ أَمْريكا الجَنوبِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: fī iḥdā duwali amrīkā l-janūbiyyah.
dialogue.en: In one of the countries of South America.
dialogue.ur: Janubi Amrika ke ek mulk mein.

dialogue.ar: كانَ في الطّائِرَةِ ثَمانِيَةٌ وَأَرْبَعونَ راكِباً.
dialogue.tr: kāna fī ṭ-ṭāʾirati thamāniyatun waʾarbaʿūna rākiban.
dialogue.en: There were forty-eight passengers on the plane.
dialogue.ur: Jahaz mein athtalees musafir the.

dialogue.ar: هَبَطَتِ الطّائِرَةُ فَجْأَةً قُرْبَ قَرْيَةٍ بَعيدَة.
dialogue.tr: habaṭati ṭ-ṭāʾiratu fajʾatan qurba qaryatin baʿīdah.
dialogue.en: The plane suddenly landed near a remote village.
dialogue.ur: Jahaz achanak ek door-daraz gaon ke qareeb utar gaya.

dialogue.ar: رَكِبَ اللُّصوصُ شاحِنَةً وَهَرَبوا.
dialogue.tr: rakiba l-luṣūṣu shāḥinatan waharabū.
dialogue.en: The robbers got into a truck and escaped.
dialogue.ur: Daaku ek truck mein baithe aur bhaag gaye.

dialogue.ar: حَمَلوا الأَمْوالَ مَعَهُمْ، وَاخْتَفَوْا.
dialogue.tr: ḥamalū l-amwāla maʿahum, wākhtafaw.
dialogue.en: They carried the money with them and disappeared.
dialogue.ur: Woh raqam apne saath le gaye aur ghaib ho gaye.

q.en: How many robbers were in the robbery news?
q.ur: Chori ki khabar mein kitne chor the?
q.ar: كَمْ لِصّاً كانوا في خَبَرِ السَّرِقَةِ؟

q.en: In which part of the world did it happen?
q.ur: Yeh duniya ke kis hisse mein hua?
q.ar: في أَيِّ جُزْءٍ مِنَ العالَمِ وَقَعَتِ الحادِثَةُ؟

q.en: How did they escape?
q.ur: Woh kaise bhaage?

q.en: What does «الأَمْوال» mean?
q.ur: «الأَمْوال» ka matlab?

intro.en: A reading about why wars happen, how the League of Nations and the United Nations were created to keep peace, and why many UN decisions are not carried out.
intro.ur: Ek tehreer ke jang kyun hoti hai, Usbat-ul-Umam aur Aqwam-e-Muttahida peace ke liye kaise bane, aur un ke kai faislon par amal kyun nahin hota.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنْ أَسْبابِ الحُروبِ، وَكَيْفَ أُنْشِئَتْ عُصْبَةُ الأُمَمِ ثُمَّ الأُمَمُ المُتَّحِدَةُ لِحِفْظِ السَّلامِ، وَلِماذا لا تُنَفَّذُ كَثيرٌ مِنْ قَراراتِها.

dialogue.ar: كُلُّ النّاسِ يَتَمَنَّوْنَ العَيْشَ في أَمْنٍ وَسَلام، لكِنَّ الحُروبَ لا تَتَوَقَّفُ في أَماكِنَ كَثيرَةٍ مِنَ العالَم.
dialogue.tr: kullu n-nāsi yatamannawna l-ʿaysha fī amnin wasalām, lākin l-ḥurūba lā tatawaqqafu fī amākina kathīratin mina l-ʿālam.
dialogue.en: All people wish to live in security and peace, but wars do not stop in many places of the world.
dialogue.ur: Sab log amn aur salamti se rehna chahte hain, lekin duniya ki bohat si jagahon par jangein nahin rukti.

dialogue.ar: وَتَنْقُلُ وَسائِلُ الإِعْلامِ إِلَيْنا أَخْبارَ القِتالِ كُلَّ يَوْم.
dialogue.tr: watanqulu wasāʾilu l-iʿlāmi ilaynā akhbāra l-qitāli kulla yawm.
dialogue.en: And the media bring us news of the fighting every day.
dialogue.ur: Aur zara'i ablagh har roz hamein ladai ki khabarein pahunchate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَذْكُرُ التّارِيخُ حُروباً قَديمَةً كَثيرَةً وَقَعَتْ بَيْنَ الشُّعوبِ، فَدَمَّرَتِ المُدُنَ وَأَضْعَفَتِ الحَضارات.
dialogue.tr: wayadhkuru t-tārīkhu ḥurūban qadīmatan kathīratan waqaʿat bayna sh-shuʿūb, fadammarati l-muduna waʾaḍʿafati l-ḥaḍārāt.
dialogue.en: History mentions many old wars that occurred between peoples, destroying cities and weakening civilisations.
dialogue.ur: Tareekh qadeem jangon ka zikr karti hai jo qaumon ke darmiyan huin, aur unhon ne shehron ko tabah aur tehzeebon ko kamzor kar diya.

dialogue.ar: كانَتْ عُصْبَةُ الأُمَمِ أَوَّلَ مُحاوَلَةٍ لِلْمُحافَظَةِ عَلى السَّلامِ بَيْنَ الدُّوَلِ، وَقَدْ قامَتْ بَعْدَ الحَرْبِ العالَمِيَّةِ الأولى.
dialogue.tr: kānat ʿuṣbatu l-umami awwala muḥāwalatin lilmuḥāfaẓati ʿalā s-salāmi bayna d-duwal, waqad qāmat baʿda l-ḥarbi l-ʿālamiyyati l-ūlā.
dialogue.en: The League of Nations was the first attempt to preserve peace among states, and it arose after the First World War.
dialogue.ur: League of Nations mulkon ke darmiyan amn qaim rakhne ki pehli koshish thi, aur woh pehli jang-e-azeem ke baad qaim hui.

dialogue.ar: لكِنَّ العُصْبَةَ لَمْ تَمْنَعْ حَرْباً عالَمِيَّةً ثانِيَةً، فَقامَتْ بَعْدَها الأُمَمُ المُتَّحِدَة.
dialogue.tr: lākin l-ʿuṣbata lam tamnaʿ ḥarban ʿālamiyyatan thāniyah, faqāmat baʿdahā l-umamu l-muttaḥidah.
dialogue.en: But the League did not prevent a second world war, so the United Nations arose after it.
dialogue.ur: Lekin League doosri jang-e-azeem ko na rok saki, is liye us ke baad Aqwam-e-Muttahida qaim hui.

dialogue.ar: وَلِلأُمَمِ المُتَّحِدَةِ مَجْلِسٌ يُسَمّى مَجْلِسَ الأَمْنِ؛ يَبْحَثُ في خِلافاتِ الدُّوَلِ، وَيَفْرِضُ عُقوباتٍ عَلى مَنْ يُهاجِمُ غَيْرَهُ.
dialogue.tr: walilʾumami l-muttaḥidati majlisun yusammā majlisa l-amn; yabḥathu fī khilāfāti d-duwal, wayafriḍu ʿuqūbātin ʿalā man yuhājimu ghayrah.
dialogue.en: The United Nations has a council called the Security Council; it looks into disagreements between states and imposes penalties on whoever attacks another.
dialogue.ur: Aqwam-e-Muttahida mein Security Council hai, jo mulkon ke jhagron ko dekhta hai aur hamla karne walon par pabandiyan laga sakta hai.

dialogue.ar: لكِنَّ كَثيرينَ يَقولونَ إِنَّها ضَعيفَةٌ، لِأَنَّ بَعْضَ الدُّوَلِ الكَبيرَةِ تُهَيْمِنُ عَلى قَراراتِها.
dialogue.tr: lākin kathīrīna yaqūlūna innahā ḍaʿīfah, liʾanna baʿḍa d-duwali l-kabīrati tuhayminu ʿalā qarārātihā.
dialogue.en: But many say it is weak, because some big states dominate its decisions.
dialogue.ur: Lekin bohat se log kehte hain ke yeh kamzor hai, kyunke kuch bare mulk is ke faislon par chhaye rehte hain.

intro.en: When we call someone with يا, the person called is the munādā. If it is a single name or a specific person, it ends with damma and is not changed: يا مُحَمَّدُ. If it is an idāfa phrase or a non-specific noun, it takes fatha: يا عَبْدَ اللهِ، يا رَجُلاً.
intro.ur: Jab hum يا se kisi ko pukarte hain to pukare gaye ko munaada kehte hain. Agar woh ek naam ya muayyan shakhs ho to damma par mabni hota hai: يا مُحَمَّدُ. Agar mudaaf ho ya ghair muayyan ho to mansoob (fatha) hota hai: يا عَبْدَ اللهِ، يا رَجُلاً.
intro.ar: إِذا نادَيْنا شَخْصاً بِـ «يا» فَهُوَ المُنادى. إِنْ كانَ عَلَماً مُفْرَداً أَوْ مَعْرِفَةً مُفْرَدَةً بُنِيَ عَلى الضَّمِّ: يا مُحَمَّدُ. وَإِنْ كانَ مُضافاً أَوْ نَكِرَةً غَيْرَ مَقْصودَةٍ نُصِبَ: يا عَبْدَ اللهِ، يا رَجُلاً.

vocab.en: first word of an idāfa phrase

intro.en: Hisham, Suhail and Rashid discuss why crime increases. They mention weak laws, the media, poverty and hunger, and say that protecting security is everyone's responsibility. Two verses of the Qur'an are quoted.
intro.ur: Hisham, Suhail aur Rashid is baat par bahas karte hain ke jurm kyun barhta hai. Woh kamzor qawaneen, media, ghurbat aur bhook ka zikr karte hain, aur kehte hain ke amn ki hifazat sab ki zimmedari hai. Quran ki do ayaat bhi aati hain.
intro.ar: يُناقِشُ هِشامٌ وَسُهَيْلٌ وَرَشيدٌ أَسْبابَ ازْدِيادِ الجَريمَةِ. يَذْكُرونَ ضَعْفَ القَوانينِ وَوَسائِلَ الإِعْلامِ وَالفَقْرَ وَالجوعَ، وَيَقولونَ إِنَّ حِفْظَ الأَمْنِ مَسْؤولِيَّةُ الجَميعِ. وَيَرِدُ في الحِوارِ آيَتانِ مِنَ القُرْآنِ.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا يَزْدادُ عَدَدُ الجَرائِمِ في أَيّامِنا؟ هذا السُّؤالُ يُشْغِلُني.
dialogue.tr: limādhā yazdādu ʿadadu l-jarāʾimi fī ayyāminā? hādhā s-suʾālu yushghilunī.
dialogue.en: Why does the number of crimes increase in our days? This question occupies me.
dialogue.ur: Hamare dinon mein jurm ki tadad kyun barhti ja rahi hai? Yeh sawal mujhe mashghool rakhta hai.

dialogue.ar: لِذلِكَ أَسْبابٌ، مِنْها أَنَّ القَوانينَ لَيْسَتْ رادِعَةً؛ فَقَدْ يُسْجَنُ المُجْرِمُ شُهوراً قَليلَةً، ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ وَيُعيدُ جَريمَتَهُ.
dialogue.tr: lidhlika asbāb, minhā anna l-qawānīna laysat rādiʿah; faqad yusjanu l-mujrimu shuhūran qalīlah, thumma yakhruju wayuʿīdu jarīmatah.
dialogue.en: There are reasons for that, among them that the laws are not deterrent; a criminal may be jailed for a few months, then comes out and repeats his crime.
dialogue.ur: Iski wajuhaat hain, jin mein se yeh ke qawaneen rok-tham karne wale nahin; mujrim chand mahine qaid hota hai, phir nikalta hai aur wahi jurm dohrata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ شَرَعَ الإِسْلامُ الحُدودَ لِحِمايَةِ المُجْتَمَعِ، قالَ تَعالى: ﴿وَلَكُمْ فِي الْقِصَاصِ حَيَاةٌ يَا أُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ﴾.
dialogue.tr: waqad sharaʿa l-islāmu l-ḥudūda liḥimāyati l-mujtamaʿ, qāla taʿālā: walakum fī l-qiṣāṣi ḥayātun yā ūlī l-albābi laʿallakum tattaqūn.
dialogue.en: Islam set the fixed penalties to protect society. Allah says: «And in retribution there is life for you, O people of understanding, that you may become righteous.»
dialogue.ur: Islam ne muashre ki hifazat ke liye hudood muqarrar kiye. Allah farmata hai: «Aur tumhare liye qisas mein zindagi hai, ae aqal walo, taake tum parhezgar bano.»

dialogue.ar: وَيَزيدُ الأَمْرَ سُوءاً أَنَّ المُجْرِمَ إِذا أَمِنَ العِقابَ تَجَرَّأَ عَلى الجَريمَةِ أَكْثَر.
dialogue.tr: wayazīdu l-amra sūʾan anna l-mujrima idhā amina l-ʿiqāba tajarraʾa ʿalā l-jarīmati akthar.
dialogue.en: And it makes matters worse that when the criminal feels safe from punishment he dares to commit more crime.
dialogue.ur: Aur baat ko aur bigarta hai ke jab mujrim saza se be-khauf ho jata hai to woh jurm par aur dilair ho jata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا أَرى أَنَّ بَعْضَ البَرامِجِ في وَسائِلِ الإِعْلامِ تُزَيِّنُ العُنْفَ لِلشَّبابِ.
dialogue.tr: waʾanā arā anna baʿḍa l-barāmiji fī wasāʾili l-iʿlāmi tuzayyinu l-ʿunfa lilshshabāb.
dialogue.en: I think that some programmes in the media make violence look attractive to young people.
dialogue.ur: Meri raaye hai ke media ke kuch programme nojawanon ko tashaddud khoobsurat dikhate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَدْفَعُ الفَقْرُ وَالجوعُ بَعْضَ النّاسِ إِلى السَّرِقَةِ أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: wayadfaʿu l-faqru wāljūʿu baʿḍa n-nāsi ilā s-sariqati ayḍan.
dialogue.en: Poverty and hunger also push some people to theft.
dialogue.ur: Ghurbat aur bhook kuch logon ko chori par bhi majboor karti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالأَمْنُ وَالغِذاءُ نِعْمَتانِ عَظيمَتانِ، قالَ تَعالى: ﴿فَلْيَعْبُدُوا رَبَّ هَٰذَا الْبَيْتِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَآمَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍ﴾.
dialogue.tr: wālʾamnu wālghidhāʾu niʿmatāni ʿaẓīmatān, qāla taʿālā: falyaʿbudū rabba hādhā l-bayti illadhī aṭʿamahum min jūʿin waʾāmanahum min khawf.
dialogue.en: Security and food are two great blessings. Allah says: «So let them worship the Lord of this House, who fed them against hunger and made them safe from fear.»
dialogue.ur: Amn aur ghiza do azeem nematein hain. Allah farmata hai: «Pas woh is ghar ke Rab ki ibadat karein, jis ne unhein bhook mein khilaya aur khauf se amn diya.»

dialogue.ar: فَلْنَتَعاوَنْ جَميعاً؛ فَالأَمْنُ لَيْسَ عَمَلَ الشُّرْطَةِ وَحْدَها، بَلْ هُوَ مَسْؤولِيَّةُ كُلِّ مُواطِن.
dialogue.tr: falnataʿāwan jamīʿan; fālʾamnu laysa ʿamala sh-shurṭati waḥdahā, bal huwa masʾūliyyatu kulli mūṭin.
dialogue.en: So let us all cooperate; security is not the work of the police alone, but the responsibility of every citizen.
dialogue.ur: Aao hum sab milkar taawun karein; amn sirf police ka kaam nahin, balke har shehri ki zimmedari hai.

vocab.ur: hum mil kar madad karte hain

intro.en: Five nouns change their ending with letters: أَبو، أَخو، حَمو، فو، ذو. They end with و when marfoo (جاءَ أَبو صَلاحٍ), with ا when mansoob (يا أَبا صَلاحٍ) and with ي when majroor (أَمْرُكُمْ يَشْغَلُ بالَ أَبيكُمْ). This works when the noun is singular and not attached to «my» (ي).
intro.ur: Paanch ism hain jin ki akhri harkat huroof se badalti hai: أَبو، أَخو، حَمو، فو، ذو. Marfoo ho to و (جاءَ أَبو صَلاحٍ), mansoob ho to ا (يا أَبا صَلاحٍ) aur majroor ho to ي (أَبيكُمْ). Shart yeh hai ke woh wahid hon aur ي mutakallim ki taraf mudaaf na hon.
intro.ar: خَمْسَةُ أَسْماءٍ تُعْرَبُ بِالحُروفِ: أَبو، أَخو، حَمو، فو، ذو. تُرْفَعُ بِالواوِ (جاءَ أَبو صَلاحٍ)، وَتُنْصَبُ بِالأَلِفِ (يا أَبا صَلاحٍ)، وَتُجَرُّ بِالياءِ (أَمْرُكُمْ يَشْغَلُ بالَ أَبيكُمْ). وَذلِكَ إِذا كانَتْ مُفْرَدَةً مُضافَةً إِلى غَيْرِ ياءِ المُتَكَلِّمِ.

q.en: Which is NOT one of the five nouns?

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ لَيْسَتْ مِنَ الأَسْماءِ الخَمْسَةِ؟

q.en: The five nouns end with و when they are:

q.ar: تَنْتَهي الأَسْماءُ الخَمْسَةُ بِالواوِ عِنْدَما تَكونُ...

intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى الكَلامِ مَعَ زَميلٍ عَنْ عُقوباتِ القَتْلِ وَالسَّرِقَةِ وَالاِغْتِصابِ في بَلَدِكَ وَفي الإِسْلامِ، وَلِماذا جَعَلَ الإِسْلامُ عُقوبَةَ المُجْرِمينَ رادِعَةً. ثُمَّ نَشاطٌ جَماعِيٌّ عَنْ أَسْبابِ الجَريمَةِ في المُجْتَمَعِ.

title.en: The effect of security on life

intro.en: A reading about how security brings happiness, health and food, how peaceful countries grow, and the three kinds of countries in the world today. It includes an Ayah and a Hadith about security.
intro.ur: Ek tehreer ke amn insan ko khushi, sehat aur ghiza deta hai, pur-aman mulk kaise taraqqi karte hain, aur aaj duniya mein teen qism ke mulk kaun se hain. Is mein Quran ki ayat aur ek hadees bhi hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنْ أَثَرِ الأَمْنِ: كَيْفَ يَجْلِبُ السَّعادَةَ وَالصِّحَّةَ وَالطَّعامَ، وَكَيْفَ تَنْمو الدُّوَلُ الآمِنَةُ، وَأَنْواعُ الدُّوَلِ الثَّلاثَةُ اليَوْمَ. وَفيهِ آيَةٌ وَحَديثٌ عَنِ الأَمْنِ.

dialogue.ar: ﴿الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوا إِيمَانَهُم بِظُلْمٍ أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمُ الْأَمْنُ وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ﴾.
dialogue.tr: alladhīna āmanū wa-lam yalbisū īmānahum bi-ẓulmin ulāʾika lahumu l-amnu wa-hum muhtadūn
dialogue.en: Those who believed and did not mix their faith with wrongdoing, for them is security, and they are guided.
dialogue.ur: Jo log iman laye aur apne iman mein zulm ki milawat nahin ki, unhi ke liye amn hai aur wahi hidayat yafta hain.

dialogue.ar: يَشْعُرُ الإِنْسانُ بِالسَّعادَةِ وَالطُّمَأْنينَةِ عَلى نَفْسِهِ وَأَهْلِهِ وَمالِهِ، حينَ يَجِدُ في بَلَدِهِ ثَلاثَةَ أَشْياءَ: الأَمْنَ وَالصِّحَّةَ وَالغِذاء.
dialogue.tr: yashʿuru l-insānu bilssaʿādati wālṭṭumaʾnīnati ʿalā nafsihi waʾahlihi wamālih, ḥīna yajidu fī baladihi thalāthata ashyāʾ: al-amna wālṣṣiḥḥata wālghidhāʾ.
dialogue.en: A person feels happiness and calm about himself, his family and his wealth, when he finds three things in his country: security, health and food.
dialogue.ur: Insan apne aap, apne ghar walon aur apne maal ke bare mein khushi aur sukoon mehsoos karta hai jab apne mulk mein teen cheezein paye: amn, sehat aur ghiza.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «مَنْ أَصْبَحَ مِنْكُمْ آمِناً في سِرْبِهِ، مُعافىً في جَسَدِهِ، عِنْدَهُ قوتُ يَوْمِهِ، فَكَأَنَّما حيزَتْ لَهُ الدُّنْيا بِحَذافيرِها».
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam: man aṣbaḥa minkum āminan fī sirbihi, muʿāfan fī jasadihi, ʿindahu qūtu yawmihi, fa-ka-annamā ḥīzat lahu d-dunyā bi-ḥadhāfīrihā
dialogue.en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Whoever among you wakes up safe in his home, healthy in his body, with his day's food, it is as if the whole world was gathered for him.
dialogue.ur: Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya: Tum mein se jo subah is haal mein uthe ke apne ghar mein aman se ho, jism mein sehatmand ho aur uske paas us din ki khurak ho, to goya uske liye poori duniya jama kar di gayi.

dialogue.ar: فَإِذا سادَ الأَمْنُ في بَلَدٍ حَصَلَ الاسْتِقْرارُ، وَنَشِطَتِ التَّنْمِيَةُ، وَاتَّجَهَ أَهْلُهُ إِلى الصِّناعَةِ وَالزِّراعَةِ وَالبِناء.
dialogue.tr: faʾidhā sāda l-amnu fī baladin ḥaṣala l-istiqrār, wanashiṭati t-tanmiyah, wāttajaha ahluhu ilā ṣ-ṣināʿati wālzzirāʿati wālbināʾ.
dialogue.en: When security prevails in a country, stability comes about, development becomes active, and its people turn to industry, agriculture and building.
dialogue.ur: Jab kisi mulk mein amn ho to istehkam aata hai, taraqqi chust hoti hai, aur log sanat, zirat aur tameer ki taraf mutawajjah hote hain.

dialogue.ar: وَإِذا غابَ الأَمْنُ وَكَثُرَتِ الجَرائِمُ، تَوَقَّفَ التَّقَدُّمُ، وَانْتَشَرَ الفَقْرُ وَالمَرَض.
dialogue.tr: waʾidhā ghāba l-amnu wakathurati l-jarāʾim, tawaqqafa t-taqaddum, wāntashara l-faqru wālmaraḍ.
dialogue.en: And when security is absent and crimes multiply, progress stops, and poverty and illness spread.
dialogue.ur: Aur jab amn na ho aur jurm barh jayein to taraqqi ruk jati hai, aur ghurbat aur bimari phail jati hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتَنْقَسِمُ دُوَلُ العالَمِ اليَوْمَ إِلى ثَلاثَةِ أَنْواعٍ: دُوَلٌ آمِنَةٌ مُسْتَقِرَّةٌ، وَدُوَلٌ تَعيشُ في حُروبٍ، وَدُوَلٌ تَتَأَرْجَحُ بَيْنَ السِّلْمِ وَالخِلافات.
dialogue.tr: watanqasimu duwalu l-ʿālami l-yawma ilā thalāthati anwāʿ: duwalun ʾāminatun mustaqirrah, waduwalun taʿīshu fī ḥurūb, waduwalun tataʾarjaḥu bayna s-silmi wālkhilāfāt.
dialogue.en: The countries of the world today are divided into three kinds: safe, stable countries, countries living in wars, and countries that swing between peace and disagreements.
dialogue.ur: Aaj duniya ke mulk teen qismon mein bante hain: pur-amn aur mustahkam mulk, jangon mein mubtala mulk, aur woh mulk jo sulah aur ikhtilafat ke darmiyan jhulte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلى الدُّوَلِ الكَبيرَةِ أَنْ تُساعِدَ الدُّوَلَ الفَقيرَةَ عَلى التَّقَدُّمِ، وَأَلّا تَبيعَها السِّلاحَ لِتُشْعِلَ الخِلافات.
dialogue.tr: waʿalā d-duwali l-kabīrati an tusāʿida d-duwala l-faqīrata ʿalā t-taqaddum, waʾallā tabīʿahā s-silāḥa litushʿila l-khilāfāt.
dialogue.en: Big countries should help poor countries to progress, and not sell them weapons to fuel disagreements.
dialogue.ur: Bare mulkon ko chahiye ke ghareeb mulkon ki taraqqi mein madad karein, aur un ko hathiyar bech kar ikhtilafat na bharkayein.

q.en: Which three things make a person happy and reassured?
q.ur: Kaun si teen cheezein insan ko khush aur mutmaeen rakhti hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ ثَلاثَةِ أُمورٍ تَجْعَلُ الإِنْسانَ سَعيداً مُطْمَئِنّاً؟

q.en: When a country has security, what becomes active?
q.ur: Amn hone par kya tez hota hai?
q.ar: عِنْدَما يَتَوَفَّرُ الأَمْنُ في بَلَدٍ، ماذا يَنْشَطُ؟

q.en: How many kinds of countries does the text mention?
q.ur: Tehreer mein mulkon ki kitni qismein hain?
q.ar: كَمْ نَوْعاً مِنَ الدُّوَلِ ذَكَرَ النَّصُّ؟

q.en: What does «الاسْتِقْرار» mean?
q.ur: «الاسْتِقْرار» ka matlab?

q.en: What should big countries do for poor countries?
q.ur: Bare mulk gareeb mulkon ke liye kya karein?
q.ar: ماذا يَجِبُ عَلى الدُّوَلِ الكَبيرَةِ نَحْوَ الدُّوَلِ الفَقيرَةِ؟

title.en: The hāl: describing how an action happened

intro.en: The hāl is an indefinite, mansoob noun that shows the state of the doer or of the object while the action happens. Its owner is definite. It answers the question: How did the action happen? Example: صَلَّتِ المَريضَةُ جالِسَةً – the sick woman prayed sitting.
intro.ur: Haal ek nakira mansoob ism hai jo kaam hote waqt fail ya maful ki haalat batata hai; us ka sahib-ul-haal maarifa hota hai. Yeh is sawal ka jawab hai: kaam kaise hua? Misal: صَلَّتِ المَريضَةُ جالِسَةً – beemar aurat ne baith kar namaz parhi.
intro.ar: الحالُ اِسْمٌ نَكِرَةٌ مَنْصوبٌ يُبَيِّنُ هَيْئَةَ الفاعِلِ أَوِ المَفْعولِ بِهِ وَقْتَ حُدوثِ الفِعْلِ، وَصاحِبُهُ مَعْرِفَةٌ. يُجيبُ عَنِ السُّؤالِ: كَيْفَ حَدَثَ الفِعْلُ؟ مِثالٌ: صَلَّتِ المَريضَةُ جالِسَةً.

q.en: The hāl answers which question?
q.ur: Haal kis sawal ka jawab hai?

q.en: The hāl is always:
q.ur: Haal hamesha hota hai:

q.en: In «صَلَّى المَريضُ جالِساً» which word is the hāl?
q.ur: «صَلَّى المَريضُ جالِساً» mein haal kaun sa lafz hai?

q.en: What does «جالِساً» mean?
q.ur: «جالِساً» ka matlab?

intro.en: Writing practice. You write two paragraphs: one about a country that lives in security and peace, and one about a country that lives in continuous wars. Then you write a short essay called الأَمْنُ وَالسَّلامُ, using the unit's texts for help.
intro.ur: Likhne ki mashq. Do paragraph likhein: ek aise mulk ke baare mein jo amn aur salamati mein hai, aur doosra aise mulk ke baare mein jo musalsal jangon mein hai. Phir unit ki tehreeron se madad le kar ek mazmoon «الأَمْنُ وَالسَّلامُ» par likhein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى الكِتابَةِ: فِقْرَتانِ، إِحْداهُما عَنْ بَلَدٍ يَعيشُ في أَمْنٍ وَسَلامٍ، وَالأُخْرى عَنْ بَلَدٍ يَعيشُ في حُروبٍ مُتَواصِلَةٍ. ثُمَّ مَوْضوعٌ قَصيرٌ بِعُنْوانِ «الأَمْنُ وَالسَّلامُ» مُسْتَعيناً بِنُصوصِ الوِحْدَةِ.

q.en: How many paragraphs are you asked to write first?
q.ur: Pehle kitne paragraph likhne hain?
q.ar: كَمْ فِقْرَةً يُطْلَبُ مِنْكَ أَنْ تَكْتُبَ أَوَّلاً؟

q.en: What does «الفِقْرَة» mean?
q.ur: «الفِقْرَة» ka matlab?

options_ar: جُزْءٌ مِنَ المَوْضوعِ يَحْمِلُ فِكْرَةً واحِدَةً

q.en: What is the essay title?
q.ur: Mazmoon ka unwaan kya hai?

q.en: What does «تَعْبير» mean?
q.ur: «تَعْبير» ka matlab?

title.en: Handwriting and spelling: the extra waw
title.ur: Khat aur imla: waw ka izafa

intro.en: Handwriting in ruq'a script with a line of poetry about learning. Spelling rule: an extra و is written but not pronounced in three places: أُولاءِ and أُولئِكَ, أُولو (meaning owners of), and at the end of عَمْرو when it is not mansoob with tanween.
intro.ur: Khat-e-ruqa mein ilm ke baare mein ek sher likhna. Imla ka qaida: teen jagah و likha jata hai magar parha nahin jata: أُولاءِ aur أُولئِكَ mein, أُولو (wale) mein, aur عَمْرو ke aakhir mein jab woh mansoob tanween wala na ho.
intro.ar: اُكْتُبْ بَيْتَ شِعْرٍ عَنِ التَّعَلُّمِ بِخَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ. وَقاعِدَةُ الإِمْلاءِ: تُكْتَبُ واوٌ زائِدَةٌ وَلا تُنْطَقُ في ثَلاثَةِ مَواضِعَ: «أُولاءِ» وَ«أُولئِكَ»، وَ«أُولو» بِمَعْنى أَصْحابِ، وَفي آخِرِ «عَمْرو» إِذا لَمْ يَكُنْ مَنْصوباً مُنَوَّناً.

dialogue.ar: تَعَلَّمْ فَلَيْسَ المَرْءُ يُولَدُ عالِماً — وَلَيْسَ أَخو عِلْمٍ كَمَنْ هُوَ جاهِلُ.
dialogue.tr: taʿallam fa-laysa l-marʾu yūladu ʿāliman — wa-laysa akhū ʿilmin kaman huwa jāhil
dialogue.en: Learn, for no one is born knowing; the man of knowledge is not like the ignorant.
dialogue.ur: Seekho, kyunke koi paida hote hi aalim nahin hota; ilm wala jahil ke barabar nahin.

q.en: In how many places is an extra و written but not pronounced?
q.ur: Kitni jagah و likha jata hai magar parha nahin jata?
q.ar: في كَمْ مَوْضِعٍ تُكْتَبُ واوٌ زائِدَةٌ وَلا تُنْطَقُ؟

q.en: In which name is the final و not pronounced?
q.ur: Kis naam ke aakhir mein و nahin parha jata?
q.ar: في أَيِّ اسْمٍ لا تُنْطَقُ الواوُ الأَخيرَةُ؟

q.en: What does «الإِمْلاء» mean?
q.ur: «الإِمْلاء» ka matlab?

q.en: The poem line says to:
q.ur: Sher kehta hai:

options: Learn, nobody is born a scholar

intro.en: A review test for Units 13 and 14. You read short passages (the Islamic world, Al-Jahiz) and answer questions, then review spelling, numbers, word usage and the countries and meanings of words you have learned.
intro.ur: Unit 13 aur 14 ki dohrai ka imtihan. Chhote paragraph parh kar (Islami duniya, Al-Jahiz) sawalon ke jawab dein, phir imla, adaad, alfaaz aur unke maani ki dohrai karein.
intro.ar: اِخْتِبارٌ لِمُراجَعَةِ الوِحْدَتَيْنِ ١٣ وَ١٤: تَقْرَأُ نُصوصاً قَصيرَةً (العالَمُ الإِسْلامِيُّ وَالجاحِظُ) وَتُجيبُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَتِها، ثُمَّ تُراجِعُ الإِمْلاءَ وَالأَعْدادَ وَاسْتِعْمالَ الكَلِماتِ وَالبُلْدانَ وَمَعانِيَ المُفْرَداتِ.

dialogue.ar: تُسَمّى الدَّوْلَةُ إِسْلامِيَّةً إِذا كانَ المُسْلِمونَ فيها أَكْثَرَ مِنْ نِصْفِ السُّكّان.
dialogue.tr: tusammā d-dawlatu islāmiyyatan idhā kāna l-muslimūna fīhā akthara min niṣfi s-sukkān.
dialogue.en: A country is called Islamic if the Muslims in it are more than half of the population.
dialogue.ur: Kisi mulk ko Islami kaha jata hai agar us mein Musalman aadhi se zyada aabadi hon.

dialogue.ar: وَتَنْتَشِرُ هذِهِ الدُّوَلُ في آسيا وَإِفْريقيا وَأَجْزاءٍ مِنْ أُوروبّا.
dialogue.tr: watantashiru hādhihi d-duwalu fī ʾāsī waʾifrīqī waʾajzāʾin min ūrūbbā.
dialogue.en: These countries are spread across Asia, Africa and parts of Europe.
dialogue.ur: Yeh mulk Asia, Africa aur Europe ke kuch hisson mein phaile hue hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَتَكَلَّمُ أَهْلُها لُغاتٍ كَثيرَةً، وَيَحْرِصُ المُسْلِمونَ عَلى تَعَلُّمِ لُغَةِ القُرْآنِ الكَريم.
dialogue.tr: wayatakallamu ahluhā lughātin kathīrah, wayaḥriṣu l-muslimūna ʿalā taʿallumi lughati l-qurʾāni l-karīm.
dialogue.en: Its people speak many languages, and Muslims are keen to learn the language of the Noble Qur'an.
dialogue.ur: Wahan ke log bohat si zabanein bolte hain, aur Musalman Quran-e-Kareem ki zaban seekhne ka shauq rakhte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَقَعُ العالَمُ الإِسْلامِيُّ بَيْنَ قارّاتِ آسيا وَإِفْريقيا وَأُوروبّا، فَمَوْقِعُهُ مِنْ أَحْسَنِ المَواقِعِ عَلى الكُرَةِ الأَرْضِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: wayaqaʿu l-ʿālamu l-islāmiyyu bayna qārrāti ʾāsī waʾifrīqī waʾūrūbbā, famawqiʿuhu min aḥsani l-mawāqiʿi ʿalā l-kurati l-arḍiyyah.
dialogue.en: The Islamic world lies between the continents of Asia, Africa and Europe, so its location is one of the best on the globe.
dialogue.ur: Islami duniya Asia, Africa aur Europe ke darmiyan waqe hai, is liye is ka muqam zameen par behtareen muqamat mein se hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلكِنَّ أَغْلى ما يَمْلِكُهُ هذا العالَمُ هُوَ الإِنْسانُ المُسْلِمُ، لا النِّفْطُ وَلا المِياه.
dialogue.tr: walkinna aghlā mā yamlikuhu hādhā l-ʿālamu huwa l-insānu l-muslim, lā n-nifṭu walā l-mīh.
dialogue.en: But the most precious thing this world owns is the Muslim person, not oil or water.
dialogue.ur: Lekin is duniya ki sab se qeemti daulat Musalman insan hai, tel ya paani nahin.

dialogue.ar: الجاحِظُ أَديبٌ عَرَبِيٌّ مَشْهورٌ، وَقَدْ أَحَبَّ القِراءَةَ مُنْذُ صِغَرِه.
dialogue.tr: al-jāḥiẓu adībun ʿarabiyyun mashhūr, waqad aḥabba l-qirāʾata mundhu ṣigharih.
dialogue.en: Al-Jahiz is a famous Arab writer, and he loved reading from his childhood.
dialogue.ur: Jahiz ek mashhoor Arab adeeb hain, aur unhein bachpan se parhna pasand tha.

q.en: When is a country called Islamic, according to the text?
q.ur: Tehreer ke mutabiq mulk Islami kab kehlata hai?
q.ar: مَتى يُسَمّى البَلَدُ إِسْلامِيّاً حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

options: When Muslims are more than 50% of the population
options_ar: عِنْدَما يَزيدُ المُسْلِمونَ عَلى نِصْفِ السُّكّانِ

q.en: What is the most important wealth of the Islamic world?
q.ur: Islami duniya ki sab se aham daulat kya hai?

q.en: Who was Al-Jahiz?
q.ur: Al-Jahiz kaun tha?

q.en: What did Al-Jahiz love as a young man?
q.ur: Al-Jahiz naujawani mein kya pasand karta tha?

q.en: What does «لُغَة» mean?
q.ur: «لُغَة» ka matlab?
